title: Unit Event — Putting Feelings Into Words — Episode5 Torn Apart

meta.Event Outline: Leo/need has begun performing in earnest at the live house. Honami comes up with a schedule to ensure that they can all work on their performance without overexerting themselves, but then she notices that Shiho seems different from usual...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! I liked your other song, but this one's starting to sound really amazing too☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: How you all feel is evident based on the way you're playing too. I can't help but smile.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'll have to keep doing my best to keep up.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What?! But you were here 'till really late last night, Miku-P! You're really gonna practice more?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: R-Rin, you didn't have to blurt it out like that...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Huh? Why not?
I just think your work ethic is amazing and you look really cool when you're really focused like that♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. Way to go, Miku.
To be fair, the girls are no slouches either.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: They don't seem happy with what they currently have.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm still not completely solid during the chorus. My voice keeps going in and out it seems...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, it still doesn't sound quite right. We could tone it down a little, but that might also make it sound dull. I'm really not sure what to do at this point.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm... We'll just have to keep making small adjustments, like how the song sounds during and around the chorus.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right. It'd be nice if we could do that...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
But it's getting pretty late.
Let's save that for tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right...
Are you free later after you get home, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'd like to make some changes to the lyrics and want someone to bounce ideas off of if you don't mind.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, of course!
I'll call you once I get home!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
We'll be fine, Shiho!
I mean, it's my melody that needs work. I want to have everything ready for next time!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
And I'll be there with her.
I already feel pretty bad about how much you've been working with us one-on-one...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami, do we need to talk about our schedule?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Huh? Oh... I-I'm sorry...
My mind must've wandered...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Is everything okay...?
You've sort of been acting like this all day.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Sorry, I didn't mean to make you all worry.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Um, Shiho...?
Can we talk after practice?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Remember how I saw you calling someone the other day? You seemed really worried about something and it's been on my mind since...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: If it's something you didn't want anyone else to know about, sorry.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I'd like to work with you and find a way to help if something really is bothering you...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I kept this from the rest of you so that you could focus on practicing our new song...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But it's affecting practice now, so I guess I don't really have a choice.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Just don't tell Ichika or anyone else, alright...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We have to sell a certain number of tickets for our next show...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Normally, bands that play at live houses have to sell tickets in order to be allowed to actually perform in a show.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Until now, the manager and the owner have been giving us a free pass.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I know how hard it is to operate a live house like that, and I felt bad about how we were being given special treatment.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I see...
I'm sorry. I had no idea.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Why are you apologizing?
It's my fault for not saying anything.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, wait...
If we have to sell tickets, then that means...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
No, it's not an issue.
I should be the one apologizing to you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But thank you. I hope things will work out next time...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Is that what you were doing, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That explains why you seemed so deflated...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: By the way, Shiho, how has it been selling tickets?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We still have to sell more...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
But you don't need to worry.
They'll all be sold in time for our show.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho, I understand that you don't want me to tell Ichika or anyone else about this, but wouldn't it be better to share the load...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wouldn't it be a lot easier than having to do this all on your own?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm actually trying to avoid that...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We're still working on our new song, right? Based on what I saw today, it's going to take a few more days to hammer everything out.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And if we have to start selling tickets to play in shows, we won't have enough time to create, practice and finish any new songs.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So for now, I want all of you to keep working on our new song. You can leave selling tickets to me.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, we'd be asking too much of you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We can keep making adjustments to the schedule. And if the others are too busy, I can help you. So, please...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You need to keep practicing too, Honami. You don't have to worry so much about me...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I want our next show to be better than our last. Ichika and Saki made these amazing songs for us, so I also want us to really know how to play them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And I'm doing this for us and Leo/need. Please, just let me handle it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, I don't want you to...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (It's true that the rest of us have to practice much more than her, but we're already cutting it so close...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Shiho may be right in saying that we should focus on practicing...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Is this really the right way to go...?
